title: Ignite sets out six on-demand AI services, delivered remotely from Africa

claims.text: Ignite describes itself as an SI-native company that provides products, data, experts, evaluation, benchmarks and intelligence as a service.
The company says it delivers this work through three arms: iBuild, iStudios and Ignite Academy.
Ignite lists six services, each offered as a service: SI products, data, experts, evaluation, benchmark and intelligence.
claims.label: Services offered

claims.text: It says it works remotely from Africa so that teams anywhere can work with it.
Ignite says it is part of Trustbridge Corp, which provides its ownership, governance and long-term direction.
The company says Ignite Academy develops SI-native experts, with capstone projects and portfolios as part of the programme.
